games.name: Smash Showdown
games.desc:
📱💻🎮 You can play on any device. (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE)
⭐ Please like and favorite the game for more updates.

💻 [CONTROLS]:
Attack – Left Click (X) (Usable mid-air)
Multi-Jump – Space (Up to 3 jumps, footstool on opponent’s head)
Dash – Q (L3) Cancel/Evasive (while Tumbled)
Block – F (RB) 
Emotes – B (R-Dpad)

Uppercut – Look Up + Attack (Y)
Down Slam – Look Down + Attack (B)

games.name: Feed A Black Hole
games.desc:
🌌A Game About Feeding a Black Hole 🌌

Your mission is simple… feed the black hole.

Throw objects into the black hole to grow its power, earn money, and unlock powerful upgrades. The more you feed it, the stronger it becomes. But beware — the universe has limits, and only the best feeders will reach the ultimate black hole.

💰 Earn Cash – Feed items into the black hole to generate money.
⚡ Buy Upgrades – Increase gravity, size, and feeding speed.
🌍 Unlock New Areas – Discover new objects to consume.
📈 Progress Faster – Upgrade your black hole to insane levels.
🏆 Climb the Leaderboards – Become the strongest black hole feeder.

Will your black hole become the ultimate cosmic force… or collapse trying?

👍 Like & Favorite the game to support development!
🔔 More updates and upgrades coming soon!*

games.name: Pomerania Roads
games.desc:
🎮 Pomerania Roads is an incredible driving experience that combines the stunning scenery of Gdańsk Pomerania with highly detailed models of various vehicles, from fast and modern to common and classic cars, together with mechanics that let you earn achievements and in-game upgrades.

💵 In the game, you can play and earn money as a mail deliverer or a store stocker. You may spend time roleplaying and socializing with people, join in various events, or just drive and explore the beautiful scenery of Polish villages.

📢 If you are looking to get updates on a regular basis, we suggest that you join our community server. Please report to our staff team any bugs, exploiters, or issues that you come across.

📱 Although we work for accessibility, please be aware that only a limited number of game features are currently supported on mobile devices.
